brief:
One year after a ceasefire agreement, Israeli expulsion orders, military incursions, and threats of renewed starvation persist in Gaza, keeping Palestinians in a state of permanent displacement, Middle East Eye reported. The ongoing operations have prevented any meaningful return to normal conditions despite the formal end to hostilities.

Palestinian residents face continued displacement as Israeli forces maintain pressure through both direct military action and administrative measures. The humanitarian situation remains precarious, with food insecurity threatening the population even as the territory nominally operates under ceasefire terms.
